notes: τόν keeps its the before Ἰορδάνην, while the articles before Ἰησοῦς, Γαλιλαίας and Ἰωάννην are unrepresented under rule 23, the ASV writing no determiner for those names.
The nominalizing τοῦ of the articular infinitive is unrepresented under rule 61 and the infinitival to is the verb's own helper, no preposition governing the construction.
